question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Adequate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adequate** means satisfactory or enough to meet a particular requirement. (पर्याप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** "We have taken adequate precautions to ensure the safety of the guests."
 
 
 
• **Sufficient** means enough to meet the needs of a situation or a proposed end. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **"The supplies were sufficient for the entire journey."
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is** 'Sufficient.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 2) Ancient **(प्राचीन) - This word means very old or belonging to the past, which is not synonymous with "adequate."
 
• **Option 3) Competent** (कुशल) - Competent means having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something well. While related, it doesn't directly convey the meaning of "adequate."
 
• **Option 4) Efficient** (कुशल)** -** Efficient means achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense. It is related to effectiveness rather than adequacy.
